findings.title: QUOTA classification still reads reviewer free text and now exhausts the reviewer immediately

findings.repair: Match QUOTA_RE (and AUTH_RE) only against stderr and CLI-generated error fields, not the reviewer's result text; for claude is_error use the subtype/error fields rather than result text; add a test with a failing reviewer whose text mentions 'rate limit'/'quota' that must be retried.

findings.title: A no-result round with failed integrity is FAILURE, not INDEPENDENCE_UNVERIFIED
findings.repair: In review_outcome, return INDEPENDENCE_UNVERIFIED when integrity.ok is not True regardless of result, so it routes to the owner (NO_REVIEWER).

findings.title: AUTH classification changes implementer/diagnosis behaviour also for configs without fallbacks
findings.repair: Either scope AUTH to role=='reviewer' or document the change and add a test; confirm intended.

findings.title: Adding reviewer_fallbacks to an in-flight run triggers GIT_CONTROL TAMPER after the CONFIG unblock
findings.repair: Re-bind control (add reviewer_exec_fallbacks) on an OWNER_UNBLOCK of a CONFIG block that introduced the chain, or document the double unblock in SKILL.md.

findings.title: max_attempts has no upper bound; large values end in STEP_LIMIT instead of a reviewer block
findings.repair: Cap max_attempts (e.g. <=5) or ensure chain_length*max_attempts < max_steps at load_config.
